items.reason: A low-strength 2.5% wash that cleanses and helps keep the look of occasional spots in check without adding extra steps.
A light, mattifying gel moisturizer that suits oily-looking skin and keeps it comfortable.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily morning protection that helps keep skin tone looking even.

response.routine_note: Wash with the benzoyl peroxide wash once a day at first (rinse well, and keep it off towels and fabrics as it can bleach them), then apply the gel moisturizer, and use the SPF every morning. If skin feels dry or irritated, wash every other day, and if spots become painful, widespread or leave marks, see a dermatologist.
